name: Dormitory
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Dormitory lies overrun by troggs and choked with radiation. Gnomes once lived here, but the fallen city's residential halls now belong to the creatures that drove them out.

sections.title: A Home Overrun
sections.body: Past the decontamination chambers of the Clean Zone, the Dormitory once housed Gnomeregan's inventors, laborers, and families. When High Tinker Mekkatorque opened the emergency radiation vents to fight the invading troggs, this crowded sector became a trap. No gnomish life remains in its communal halls or living quarters. Mutated troggs now thrive in the radioactive air. Travelers heading deeper through the city must fight through this reminder of the catastrophe to reach the lower Hall of Gears.

sections.title: Punchograph Terminals
sections.body: The abandoned living quarters still hold working machines from Gnomeregan's administration. Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. Their cards grant access to higher-security data terminals deeper in the city, helping recover important records left behind when the gnomes fled.

faq.q: What was the Dormitory used for before the fall?
faq.answer: The Dormitory housed Gnomeregan's inventors, workers, and their families. Its location near industrial and civic sectors gave residents easy access to their workstations and sleeping bunks before toxic radiation flooded the lower corridors.

faq.q: Why is the Dormitory infested with troggs?
faq.answer: When the troggs broke into the city from below, High Tinker Mekkatorque flooded it with toxic gas to kill them. Radiation instead mutated the troggs that survived, making them more vicious and entirely resistant to the irradiated residential blocks.
The Dormitory lies just beyond the Clean Zone's sanitized airlocks and connects the upper levels to the lower Hall of Gears. Anyone pressing deeper into Gnomeregan must pass through it.

faq.q: What are the Matrix Punchograph machines found here?
faq.answer: Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. The encoded cards grant access to higher-security terminals, helping recover important data left behind in Gnomeregan.

angles.text: For a gnome, the Dormitory was once home. Now irradiated rubble fills the halls, overrun by the brutes who drove your people from it.
Even amid a failure of bio-containment, automated Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals still process algorithmic security punch cards flawlessly.
